captions.caption: Bright lights and flares are visible in the distance over a dark desert horizon.
Multiple projectiles leave glowing trails across the night sky as they are fired.
The sky is filled with numerous arcing streaks of light from continuous military firing.
Smoke trails from the projectiles are visible against the dark sky above the target area.
Observers in traditional Arabic dress sit in decorated chairs under a white tent.
A man stands near the front of the tent structure, looking out at the distant lights.
A sudden, large explosion occurs on the horizon, creating a bright orange flash.
A powerful blast sound is heard as a large fireball rises from the ground.
Further explosions follow the initial blast, lighting up the desert landscape.
The audience under the tent remains seated and focused on the military display.
Small fires continue to burn on the ground where the projectiles landed.
A person in the foreground holds up a smartphone to record the nighttime exercise.
Thick smoke from the ongoing bombardment hangs in the air over the horizon.
Distant figures are seen moving in the shadows near the edge of the viewing platform.
The camera captures a wide shot of the desert under a steady stream of fire.
A new set of flares is launched, creating multiple bright points in the sky.
Rapid tracer rounds zip across the dark background in quick, successive bursts.
The sound of heavy machinery or vehicle movement is audible in the distance.
Orange glows from ground impacts illuminate the drifting smoke clouds above.
A man in a white ghutra and thobe is seen from behind, sitting in the front row.
The military operation continues with consistent flashes of light along the horizon.
Smoke from the multiple explosions drifts slowly across the camera's field of view.
The horizon line is marked by numerous small, glowing fires and embers.
An Arabic voice over a loudspeaker provides commentary on the ongoing exercise.
Bright streaks of light continue to arc from left to right across the dark sky.
The intensity of the firing fluctuates, with brief lulls followed by intense barrages.
A large, bright flash signals a significant impact on a target in the distance.
A massive explosion sound is heard, followed by a large plume of orange fire.
Several secondary explosions are visible within the main fire on the horizon.
Observers watch as a large section of the desert floor is engulfed in flames.
Debris and smoke are kicked up by the force of the powerful detonations.
The sound of rapid-fire weapons joins the deep booms of the heavy artillery.
More tracer rounds create a complex pattern of light in the smoke-filled sky.
The smoke layer thickens, partially obscuring the distant lights and fires.
Some of the seated observers lean forward to get a clearer view of the action.
A red status light on a piece of equipment near the observers flashes periodically.
The horizon remains illuminated by the persistent glow of the military exercise.
Projectiles are seen falling vertically into the target area, causing small flashes.
The camera pans slightly to the right, showing more of the tent's interior.
A person in a camouflage military uniform is briefly visible on the left side.
The night sky is briefly lit up by a series of rapid, bright flashes.
A low, continuous rumbling sound suggests the movement of heavy vehicles.
A sudden, massive explosion creates a giant fireball that dominates the horizon.
The sound of the massive blast is very loud, causing a slight camera shake.
A huge column of fire and black smoke rises into the air after the impact.
Smaller, secondary explosions continue to occur around the main blast site.
The crowd under the tent is visibly impressed by the scale of the detonation.
A man in dark clothing walks across the area between the tent and the field.
Another significant explosion occurs, creating a bright, blinding white flash.
The desert ground is illuminated brightly by a series of powerful explosions.
Large flames erupt from the target zone, casting flickering light into the tent.
The sound of clapping and appreciative murmurs is heard from the audience.
Observers continue to watch as the large fires on the horizon burn brightly.
A soldier in full camouflage uniform stands at attention near a tent pole.
The horizon is a bright, chaotic mix of fire, smoke, and falling embers.
Additional tracer rounds are fired into the thick smoke hanging over the site.
A man's voice begins a formal address over the loudspeaker system as the firing subsides.
The audience under the tent applauds as the military demonstration concludes.
Several men in traditional white thobes are shown seated in the front row.
The video concludes with a view of the spectators looking out from under the tent.
